title.zh: Anthropic设立公共利益基金：初始承诺5%股份，公司估值上涨将自动追加
title.en: Anthropic设立公共利益基金：初始承诺5%股份，公司估值上涨将自动追加

current_state.zh: Anthropic已宣布设立公共利益基金并承诺5%股份，但该承诺仍需股东批准，尚不能确认已正式完成；基金采用全资LLC结构，含估值上涨自动追加2%的机制，并禁止用于政治游说或政治捐款；连同联合创始人和员工承诺，约20%股份将用于公共利益。公司同时筹备最早11月IPO。
current_state.en: Anthropic has announced a Public Benefit Fund with a 5% share commitment, but the commitment remains subject to stockholder approval and is not confirmed as completed; the fund is a wholly owned LLC with a 2% share ratchet per 50% valuation increase and is barred from political lobbying or donations; including co-founder and employee pledges, roughly 20% of shares are intended for public causes. The company is also preparing an IPO as soon as November.

updates.title_en: Anthropic设立公共利益基金：初始承诺5%股份，公司估值上涨将自动追加
updates.what_changed_zh: Anthropic 推出“Anthropic 公共利益基金”，以公司 5% 股权作为初始资金，其结构设定为估值每上涨 50% 便自动增持 2%，并明确禁止用于政治游说或捐款；这是其将约 20% 总股份投入公共利益事业（包括应对 AI 引发的劳动力冲击）的更广泛承诺的一部分。
updates.what_changed_en: Anthropic launched an 'Anthropic Public Benefit Fund' seeded with 5% of company equity, structured to automatically grow by 2% per 50% valuation increase and explicitly barred from political lobbying or donations, part of a broader commitment putting roughly 20% of total shares toward public-interest causes including AI-driven labor disruption.

updates.title_zh: Anthropic 将自身 5% 捐给公众，马斯克以捐出 SpaceX 股份回应
updates.title_en: Anthropic Gives 5% of Itself to the Public. Musk Answers by Giving Away SpaceX Shares
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增关键程序性事实：该5%股份承诺仍需股东批准，因此不能视为已正式落地；基金为全资LLC，董事会可在估值较未披露基准上涨50%时追加2%股份；Anthropic正筹备最早11月IPO，报道估值约2万亿美元；联合创始人承诺捐出80%股权并设员工配捐。
updates.what_changed_en: Adds material procedural details: the 5% share commitment is subject to stockholder approval, so it is not confirmed as launched; the fund is a wholly owned LLC whose board can add 2% of shares each time valuation rises 50% above an undisclosed baseline; Anthropic is preparing an IPO as soon as November at a reported ~$2 trillion valuation; co-founders pledged 80% of their equity with an employee matching program.
updates.current_state_zh: Anthropic已宣布设立公共利益基金并承诺5%股份，但该承诺仍需股东批准，尚不能确认已正式完成；基金采用全资LLC结构，含估值上涨自动追加2%的机制，并禁止用于政治游说或政治捐款；连同联合创始人和员工承诺，约20%股份将用于公共利益。公司同时筹备最早11月IPO。
updates.current_state_en: Anthropic has announced a Public Benefit Fund with a 5% share commitment, but the commitment remains subject to stockholder approval and is not confirmed as completed; the fund is a wholly owned LLC with a 2% share ratchet per 50% valuation increase and is barred from political lobbying or donations; including co-founder and employee pledges, roughly 20% of shares are intended for public causes. The company is also preparing an IPO as soon as November.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic said it will dedicate 5% of its shares to a new Public Benefit Fund — with about 20% of its stock going to public causes including co-founder and employee pledges — and Elon Musk responded by promising one SpaceX share to every child in the United States next year, a giveaway worth over $10 billion at current prices.
